newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police avoid murder by smashing Mafia clan.
newsitem.headline: Italian police avoid murder by smashing Mafia clan.

text.p: Italian police said on Saturday they had arrested 28 alleged members of a Mafia clan, in part to avoid what they believed would be a planned "settling of accounts" within the group's ranks.
Police said they understood the crime syndicate had been led by jailed boss Salvatore Cappello and trafficked in marijuana and cocaine in the western Sicilian city of Catania.
They told a news conference the group had been planning to kill one its members, studying the would-be victim's movements and selecting a place and weapon for the murder.

A hitman had been chosen and was simply awaiting the right moment, police said, adding that the operation was the result of an investigation opened into the group following the murder of a local mobster.
